steps.title: Sourcing & vetting
steps.description: We work directly with an established producer with real facilities and industrial-scale output. Not university labs. Not brokers reselling from Alibaba.

steps.title: Independent testing
steps.description: Independent lab testing of our launch materials is underway at US laboratories. Raman spectroscopy, SEM/EDS, XRD, AFM: we build the TDS and COA that procurement teams actually trust.

steps.title: Regulatory support
steps.description: We work with U.S. regulatory counsel on TSCA and import requirements so you can evaluate with confidence. We also handle customs classification, SDS documentation, and import logistics.

steps.title: U.S.-based support
steps.description: Responsive U.S. support and coordinated delivery. We're your stateside partner, not a middleman overseas you can't reach on the phone.
